message.subject: Collaboration with EDXSO on practical school technology
message.email_body: School leadership and practical collaboration tools are critical to shaping successful academic environments today. Your recent video, ISTE 2026: Practical Tools for Teacher Collaboration with Kevin Donohue, highlights how technology can streamline these efforts. At EDXSO, we focus on leadership and academic outcomes. We would love to explore a co-created educational resource about practical technology in schools. This offers a chance to develop useful content with our consulting team and discuss a suitable format. Would you be open to a brief conversation?
